Title: Easier diagnostics and logging with Azure Kubernetes Service is now in preview

Body.Content:
Diagnosing and troubleshooting problems are among the main challenges of running Kubernetes today. 

Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) diagnostics, now available in preview, provides a guided and interactive experience to help you diagnose and solve potential issues with AKS clusters. AKS diagnostics analyzes backend telemetry from AKS clusters and benchmarks that information with specific AKS domain knowledge and best practices. It’s all packaged in a user-friendly interface that allows you to easily isolate the issue and determine next steps. 

Learn more
